subject: mathematics
concept: Determining whether a relationship (table, graph, or equation) represents a proportional relationship
source_inspiration: adapted from Japan MEXT Courses of Study sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student checks whether the ratio stays constant across a set of physical quantity pairs
exercise.pictorial: Student identifies which of several pictured graphs shows a proportional relationship (straight line through the origin)
exercise.abstract: Student determines whether a given table or equation represents a proportional relationship, explaining why

misconception_flags: identifies a straight-line relationship as proportional even when it doesn't pass through the origin

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
